sponsor_delegation: After the offline packet was opened, the sponsor asked the agent to perform the review itself and continue ('ban hay tu su dung claude-in-chrome de review va lam cac buoc tiep theo'). The browser extension was not connected, so the agent reviewed the same packet media directly (frame extraction, PCM comparison, pixel measurement).

deviations.statement: One reviewer; spec §9 asks for at least two.
The registered reviewer was the sponsor; the sponsor delegated the review to the agent. No human reviewed these artifacts.
The reviewer implemented the code and the packet under review.
Reviewed from an offline packet, without the in-app showrunner-grant custody (that custody was exercised in M8-E).

Labels hid the cohort, but both cohorts' stimuli are pixel-identical (only the tone differs), the output shape reveals the profile, and the reviewer saw the per-cohort spatial data while checking spans.

Spatial frames were drawn to match the pinned fixture response, so the review checks that spans, evidence classes and gaps survive the pipeline intact; it says nothing about a vision model's perception.
Retained from the protocol; the zh-shuang stimuli contain no text, so language was not exercised.

packet_defects: The packet page drew only the first span box per frame for the two-view 'yellow painting'; the reviewer verified that assertion by pixel measurement instead.
non_authorization: No production activation, deployment, provider or platform call, credential use or publication is authorized.
